entries.name: The Jester (Goomba)
entries.look:
The Jester is a Goomba who used the shape or role of Bowser Jr. as part of the historical deception that preceded the castle assault. The performance was funny only until Bowser woke up and found that the joke had been used to move a hostile plan inside his walls. The Jester’s importance is not that a Goomba put on a ridiculous performance. Bowser’s court had survived ridiculous performances before. The importance is that the false Bowser Jr. session occupied Bowser’s attention while the castle’s loyalties, routes, and defenders were being rearranged around him.
